en-US.heroPrimary: CS 121 / IN4MATX 141 is UCI's information retrieval course: how search engines collect, process, index, and rank web documents.
en-US.heroSecondary: This page collects week-by-week notes for classmates who want a structured review of text processing, the web graph, SEO and spam, web crawling, the ethics and law around collecting web data, and text processing and term-document matrices.
en-US.readerDescription: This page presents {course}{weekPhrase} notes in a structured reading format so you can review text processing, the web graph, SEO, web crawling, and how search engines index and rank pages week by week. The path below takes you back to Notes, Course Notes, the course page, or this note file. Hover over the ≡ icon on the right side to open the Table of Contents.
